projects.name: MetricStudio
projects.desc: Plotly-based data workspace: import, drag-and-drop charts, dashboards, and AI answers with citations.
projects.overview: A Plotly-based desktop workspace for personal data analysis: import data, clean and transform it, build charts by drag and drop, compose interactive dashboards, and ask questions of it with AI — all without sending data off the machine.
highlights: Drag-and-drop chart configuration with a live properties panel
Dashboard composition plus a SQL workbench and command palette
AI answers computed by deterministic pandas tools, not model guesswork
Every figure carries a [n] citation back to the exact tool result
Statistical tests (Welch t, Mann-Whitney U, regression) run in scipy
Dataset content is treated as untrusted input and fenced from instructions
projects.decisions: Trust is the feature. Numbers come from pandas tools, not from the model reading a data sample; statistics come from scipy, and the LLM only explains them. When an answer cannot show its source, it is not an answer.
projects.next: Actively developed — the public repo is at v1.15.0.

projects.name: SecKeyBox
projects.desc: Local-first password manager for developers — 8 credential types, Argon2id + AES-256-GCM.
projects.overview: A local-first password manager built for developers. Instead of forcing every secret into a website-and-password shape, it ships eight purpose-built credential types and keeps everything encrypted on your own machine.
highlights: Eight credential types: account, API key, env vars, database, SSH, cloud, license, SMTP
Per-field AES-256-GCM with a random nonce; key derived via Argon2id (m=64 MB)
Master password rotation re-encrypts every stored secret
Built-in TOTP, password generator, secret history and a local security audit
Auto-lock after inactivity and clipboard auto-clear after copying
Import/export, with bulk import from Chrome, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass
projects.decisions: Cryptography is only half the job — the other half is default behaviour. Zero built-in credentials, auto-lock, clipboard clearing and a local audit dashboard are what make a vault trustworthy in daily use.
projects.next: Tauri 2 + React + Rust; releases ship through tag-triggered 3-platform CI.

projects.name: Perf Analyzer
projects.desc: Streamlit analyzer for resource-usage Excel data: scenario comparison, leak detection, auto reports.
projects.overview: A Streamlit application for analysing application resource-usage data exported to Excel: scenario comparison, trend reading, threshold anomalies, leak detection, version regression, resource efficiency, capacity estimation and an automatically generated test report.
highlights: Every sheet is a scenario; the first sheet is system information
Memory-leak detection, version regression judgement and capacity estimation
Threshold-based anomaly scanning across CPU, memory and handles
Companion psutil collector whose output the analyzer recognizes with zero mapping
Written methodology doc so every metric definition is reviewable
projects.decisions: Performance numbers only persuade when the definition behind every metric is written down. The methodology document ships with the tool, so a finding can be argued with instead of merely believed.
projects.next: Actively maintained; the collector and the analysis modes evolve together.

projects.name: AtomGit AccountLens
projects.desc: Pure-frontend lens for GitCode / AtomGit accounts: repos, languages, commits and activity.
projects.overview: A pure-frontend analysis lens for GitCode / AtomGit accounts. Paste a personal access token and get a full visual read on repositories, languages, commits and activity — every request goes straight to the platform API, so data never leaves the browser.
highlights: Overview, repository profiling, activity heatmaps and a shareable annual report
Language composition switchable between repo-weighted and star-weighted
Deep fetch with a serial rate-limit queue, exponential backoff and resumable runs
Snapshots cached in localStorage, with an explicit refresh instead of silent staleness
Vitest coverage on throttling, aggregation and storage logic, wired into CI
projects.decisions: Rate limiting is a product feature. A queue you can interrupt, resume and reason about beats an eight-second spinner with no explanation.
projects.next: Deployed as a static site through GitHub Actions.

projects.name: LinkCollections
projects.desc: Cross-platform bookmark manager: folders, tags, search, dual views and ECharts statistics.
projects.overview: A modern cross-platform bookmark manager: folders and tags, card and list views, full-text search, one-click opening in the browser you choose — plus access statistics charted with ECharts.
highlights: Folder and tag organisation with a card / list dual view
Full-text search across titles, URLs and descriptions
Access counts and last-visited time per bookmark
Favicon fetching with a graceful fallback
Light and dark themes on top of Element Plus
projects.decisions: Small daily tools are used dozens of times a day, so the details that matter are favicon loading, one-click open and remembering what you actually click.
projects.next: MIT licensed and open to contributions.
